description: 《La Isla Bonita》描寫一段充滿浪漫、懷念與異國風情的美好回憶。歌中的主角夢見曾經深愛的 San Pedro，回想那裡溫暖的陽光、熱帶海風、動人的音樂與自由自在的生活。她懷念島上純樸而熱情的人們，也記得曾經令人心動的愛情與甜蜜時光。雖然那些美好的日子早已匆匆流逝，但熟悉的旋律與景色依然深深留在心中，令她渴望再次回到那片樂土。最終，《La Isla Bonita》傳達的是對愛情、自由與美好歲月的眷戀：有些地方因承載著珍貴的回憶而變得無可取代，即使時間流逝，仍能在夢中帶給我們溫暖、幸福與心靈的慰藉。

vocabulary.usage: 說睡覺時夢見某個人或地方，或平常很希望得到某件事時，可以用 dream of + 人／事物。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「dream of」表示「夢見或嚮往」？
options: I dream of visiting that beautiful island one day.
I dream of this soup with a spoon because it is hot.
The hotel dreams of five stars, so it sleeps all afternoon.
Please dream of the door before you open it.
optionExplanations: 我夢想有一天造訪那座美麗的島嶼，dream of + V-ing 用法自然。
dream of 不能表示用湯匙喝湯；可說 I eat this hot soup with a spoon.
把飯店評等的「星星」當成飯店睡覺時會做的夢；若要表達評等，可說 The hotel wants five stars.
dream of 不是「檢查」或「想起」門的動作；可說 Please check the door before you open it.
vocabulary.explanation: 我夢想有一天造訪那座美麗的島嶼，dream of + V-ing 用法自然。

vocabulary.usage: 一件事讓你聯想到另一件事，或某個回憶感覺很近時，可用 seem(s) like。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「seem like」？
options: She seems like her shoes because they are the same size.
Our trip seems like yesterday, even though it was years ago.
The meeting seems like at five because the clock is busy.
I seem like my keys in the kitchen every morning.
optionExplanations: seems like 不能直接表示鞋子的尺寸相同；可說 Her shoes are the same size.
旅程雖在多年前，感覺卻像昨天才發生，符合 seems like yesterday 的常見用法。
seem like 不是用來報告會議開始時間；可說 The meeting starts at five.
seem like 不是尋找東西；可說 I look for my keys in the kitchen every morning.
vocabulary.explanation: 旅程雖在多年前，感覺卻像昨天才發生，符合 seems like yesterday 的常見用法。

vocabulary.usage: 描寫海邊、花園或戶外吹來的柔和風時使用。
options: I put the breeze in the fridge to keep it cold.
A cool breeze came through the window.
The chef added two breezes to the cake.
The bus is late because a breeze forgot its ticket.
optionExplanations: 微風不是能裝進冰箱的物品；可說 I put the water in the fridge to keep it cold.
一陣涼爽的微風吹進窗內，breeze 正確指輕柔的風。
微風不是蛋糕材料；可說 The chef added two eggs to the cake.
微風不會買車票或搭公車；可說 The bus is late because of heavy traffic.
vocabulary.explanation: 一陣涼爽的微風吹進窗內，breeze 正確指輕柔的風。

vocabulary.meaning: 野性而自由的；不受拘束的。
vocabulary.usage: 描述野生動物、自然環境或不受拘束的感覺。Wild 不一定代表危險。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「wild and free」？
options: The bank says my money is wild and free, so it ran away.
The museum is wild and free because it closes at five.
These birds live wild and free in the forest.
My homework is wild and free because it has no name.
optionExplanations: 把錢當成會自己逃跑的野生動物；可說 I cannot find my money.
博物館五點關門是營業時間，不代表 wild and free；可說 The museum closes at five.
鳥在森林裡自由生活，符合 wild and free 描述自然、不受拘束的意思。
作業沒寫名字不代表「野性而自由」；可說 My homework has no name on it.
vocabulary.explanation: 鳥在森林裡自由生活，符合 wild and free 描述自然、不受拘束的意思。

vocabulary.usage: 比普通的 want to 更強烈，通常用 long to + 原形動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「long to」？
options: The ruler longs to the desk because it is thirty centimeters.
The clock longs to twelve when it feels tired.
This road longs to the airport for ten miles.
After a cold winter, I long to see the sea again.
optionExplanations: 把 long 當成「長度」後，誤接成 long to；可說 The ruler is thirty centimeters long.
時鐘不會因為疲倦而「渴望」指向十二點；可說 The clock shows twelve.
long to 不是用來量道路長度；可說 The road to the airport is ten miles long.
經過寒冬，我非常盼望再次看見大海，long to see 正確。
vocabulary.explanation: 經過寒冬，我非常盼望再次看見大海，long to see 正確。

vocabulary.usage: 不只能愛上人，也能愛上一個地方或一件事。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「fall in love with」？
options: We fell in love with the small town during our holiday.
My suitcase fell in love with the airport and refused to leave.
I fell in love with the floor and hurt my knee.
The waiter fell in love with the bill, so he paid it twice.
optionExplanations: 旅行時愛上某座小鎮，fall in love with + 地方 很自然。
行李箱不會因為愛上機場而拒絕離開；可說 My suitcase was left at the airport.
把 fall in love 的 fall 誤當成真的跌倒；可說 I fell on the floor and hurt my knee.
付兩次帳單不能證明「愛上帳單」；可說 The waiter paid the bill twice by mistake.
vocabulary.explanation: 旅行時愛上某座小鎮，fall in love with + 地方 很自然。

vocabulary.usage: 說活動、天氣、感情或某個狀態維持多久時，last 可以當動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「last」表示「持續」？
options: The train lasted the station and became the first train.
I last my coat before I leave the house.
The calendar says Friday will last because it is the last day of work.
optionExplanations: 把 last 和「第一／最後」的排名混在一起；可說 The train arrived at the station first.
演唱會持續兩小時，lasted two hours 用法正確。
last 不是穿外套的動作；可說 I put on my coat before I leave the house.
把星期五是一週工作日的最後一天，誤認成它會永久持續；可說 Friday is the last workday of the week.
vocabulary.explanation: 演唱會持續兩小時，lasted two hours 用法正確。

vocabulary.usage: 例如 The days went by quickly 指日子過得很快；也可說看著人們從旁經過。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用了「go by」表示「時間流逝」？
options: My camera went by the picture to make it bigger.
The doctor told my headache to go by the front door.
The shop goes by five dollars when it sells bread.
The summer days went by so fast.
optionExplanations: go by 不是放大照片的動作；可說 My camera can make the picture bigger.
頭痛不是會依醫師指示從大門離開的訪客；可說 The doctor gave me medicine for my headache.
go by 不能表示商品售價；可說 The shop sells bread for five dollars.
夏日過得很快，went by 正確表達時間流逝。
vocabulary.explanation: 夏日過得很快，went by 正確表達時間流逝。

vocabulary.meaning: 搖籃曲、哄人入睡的輕柔歌曲。
vocabulary.usage: 形容大人唱給嬰兒或孩子聽、幫助入睡的歌。
options: The football team sang a lullaby to make the ball sleep.
The library asked me to return my lullaby because it was late.
Her father sang a soft lullaby to the baby.
The alarm clock played a lullaby to wake up the whole street.
optionExplanations: 搖籃曲是給人聽的歌，不是讓足球睡覺的方法；可說 The football team sang a song after the game.
把搖籃曲當成圖書館一定要歸還的書；可說 The library asked me to return my book.
爸爸唱輕柔的搖籃曲給寶寶聽，意思正確。
鬧鐘用來叫醒人，lullaby 通常是安撫入睡；可說 The alarm clock rang loudly and woke everyone up.
vocabulary.explanation: 爸爸唱輕柔的搖籃曲給寶寶聽，意思正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 無憂無慮、沒有什麼煩惱。
vocabulary.usage: 形容一個人很放鬆，暫時不為事情擔心；常見說法是 without a care in the world。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句最自然地表達「no cares in the world」的意思？
options: She lay in the sun without a care in the world.
The beach has no cares because nobody gave it a job.
I put all my cares in a box and mailed them to the moon.
The world has no cares because it forgot its bag at home.
optionExplanations: 她悠閒地躺在陽光下，沒有什麼煩惱；without a care in the world 是自然慣用語。
海灘不會因為沒有工作而沒有煩惱；可說 People can relax on the beach.
cares 在這裡指煩惱，不是能裝箱寄出的物品；可說 I tried to forget my worries.
「世界忘記帶包包」不能說明一個人無憂無慮；可說 I forgot my bag at home.
vocabulary.context: 教學提醒：：先讓學生說出錯誤選項「到底誤會了哪個意思」，再揭曉解析。fall in love with 可以接地方，go by 可以指時間流逝，也可以指經過；no cares in the world 在日常例句中可改用更常見的 without a care in the world。笑點不需要特別解釋成笑話，直接用正確英文修復錯誤即可。
vocabulary.explanation: 她悠閒地躺在陽光下，沒有什麼煩惱；without a care in the world 是自然慣用語。
